sql.processStepAction.getActionsForStep: -- This query is duplicated in "projectProcessStep.getProjectProcessStep". Keep then in sync (or eventually combine them) select psa.*, cpsst.id as company_process_step_status_type_id, cpsst.process_step_status_type_id, cpsst.process_step_status_type, cpst.project_status_type, cpst.project_status_type_id, at.action_type, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(logic))) FROM ( SELECT psl.id, psl.archived, psl.process_step_requirement_id as "processStepRequirementId", psl.operation_type_id as "operationTypeId", ot.operation_type as "operationType", ot.operation_code as "operationCode", psl.created_by_id as "createdById", psl.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", psr.requirement_nbr as "requirementNbr", psr.immutable as "processStepRequirementImmutable", psl.sql_order as "sqlOrder" FROM flow.process_step_logic psl left join flow.operation_type ot on ot.id = psl.operation_type_id left join flow.process_step_requirement psr on psr.id = psl.process_step_requirement_id WHERE psl.process_step_action_id = psa.id and psl.archived is not true ORDER BY psl.sql_order ) logic), '[]') AS "processStepLogicList", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(children))) FROM ( SELECT psacp.id, psacp.archived, psacp.process_step_action_id as "processStepActionId", psacp.process_step_id as "processStepId", psacp.display_order as "displayOrder", psacp.created_by_id as "createdById", psacp.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", ps.process_step_name as "processStepName", ( select count(*) from flow.process_step_action psa where psa.process_step_id = ps.id and psa.trigger_automatically is true and psa.archived is not true ) as "autoTriggerActionCount" FROM flow.process_step_action_child_process psacp inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = psacp.process_step_id WHERE psacp.process_step_action_id = psa.id and psacp.archived is not true order by psacp.display_order, ps.process_step_name ) children), '[]') AS "processStepActionChildProcesses", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(childFn))) FROM ( SELECT psacf.id, psacf.archived, psacf.process_step_action_id as "processStepActionId", psacf.company_function_id as "companyFunctionId", psacf.display_order as "displayOrder", psacf.created_by_id as "createdById", psacf.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", cf.company_function_name as "companyFunctionName", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(params))) FROM ( select apdv.id, apdv.archived, dfp.db_function_id as "dbFunctionId", dfp.parameter_name as "parameterName", dfp.data_type_id as "dataTypeId", apdv.db_function_param_id as "dbFunctionParamId", apdv.process_step_action_company_function_id as "processStepActionCompanyFunctionId", apdv.dynamic_value as "dynamicValue" from flow.db_function_param dfp left join flow.action_param_dynamic_value apdv on apdv.db_function_param_id = dfp.id and apdv.process_step_action_company_function_id = psacf.id where dfp.db_function_id = cf.db_function_id and dfp.parameter_type_id = 2 and apdv.archived is not true ) params), '[]') AS "actionParamDynamicValues" FROM flow.process_step_action_company_function psacf inner join flow.company_function cf on cf.id = psacf.company_function_id WHERE psacf.process_step_action_id = psa.id and psacf.archived is not true order by psacf.display_order, cf.company_function_name ) childFn), '[]') AS "processStepActionChildFunctions", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT psal.id, psal.archived, psal.process_step_action_id as "processStepActionId", psal.created_by_id as "createdById", psal.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", l.link, l.url FROM flow.process_step_action_link psal inner join flow.link l on l.id = psal.link_id WHERE psal.process_step_action_id = psa.id and psal.archived is not true order by l.link ) links), '[]') AS "processStepActionLinks" from flow.process_step_action psa left join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on cpsst.id = psa.company_process_step_status_type_id left join flow.company_project_status_type cpst on cpst.id = psa.company_project_status_type_id inner join flow.action_type at on at.id = psa.action_type_id where case when :processStepId::integer is not null then psa.process_step_id = :processStepId else 1 = 1 end and case when :id::integer is not null then psa.id = :id else 1 = 1 end and psa.archived is not true order by psa.display_order
sql.processStepAction.deleteAction: update flow.process_step_action set modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now(), archived = true where id = :actionId
sql.processStepAction.actionsUsingRequiremen: select psa.id, psa.action_name, ps.process_step_name from flow.process_step_logic psl inner join flow.process_step_action psa on psa.id = psl.process_step_action_id inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = psa.process_step_id where psl.process_step_requirement_id = :requirementId and psl.archived is not true and psa.archived is not true
sql.processStepAction.updateActionDisplayOrd: update flow.process_step_action set display_order = :displayOrder, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStepAction.updateAction: update flow.process_step_action set action_name = :actionName, trigger_automatically = :triggerAutomatically, time_based_trigger = :timeBasedTrigger, hidden = :hidden, action_type_id = :actionTypeId, company_process_step_status_type_id = :companyProcessStepStatusTypeId, company_project_status_type_id = :companyProjectStatusTypeId, always_enabled = :alwaysEnabled, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStepAction.insertAction: insert into flow.process_step_action(process_step_id, action_name, trigger_automatically, action_type_id, company_process_step_status_type_id, company_project_status_type_id, created_by_id, archived, display_order, time_based_trigger, hidden) values (:processStepId, :actionName, :triggerAutomatically, :actionTypeId, :companyProcessStepStatusTypeId, :companyProjectStatusTypeId, :createdById, false, (select coalesce(max(display_order) + 1, 0) from flow.process_step_action where process_step_id = :processStepId and archived is not true), :timeBasedTrigger, :hidden)
sql.processStepAction.archiveOldLogic: update flow.process_step_logic set archived = true, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById where process_step_action_id = :id;
sql.processStepAction.insertLogic: insert into flow.process_step_logic (process_step_requirement_id, operation_type_id, sql_order, process_step_action_id, date_created, created_by_id) values (:processStepRequirementId, :operationTypeId, :sqlOrder, :id, now(), :createdById)
sql.processStepAction.getChildProcessStepsFo: select ps.* from flow.process_step ps where ps.id != :stepId and ps.company_id = :companyId and ps.archived is not true and not exists ( select acp.process_step_action_id from flow.process_step_action_child_process acp where acp.process_step_id = ps.id and acp.process_step_action_id = :actionId and acp.archived is not true ) order by ps.process_step_name
sql.processStepAction.addChildStepToAction: insert into flow.process_step_action_child_process (process_step_action_id, process_step_id, display_order, created_by_id) values (:processStepActionId, :processStepId, :displayOrder, :createdById)
sql.processStepAction.getActionChildStep: select cp.id, cp.process_step_action_id, cp.process_step_id, cp.display_order, cp.archived, cp.date_created, cp.date_modified, cp.created_by_id, cp.modified_by_id, ps.process_step_name from flow.process_step_action_child_process cp inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = cp.process_step_id where cp.id = :id
sql.processStepAction.deleteActionChildStep: update flow.process_step_action_child_process set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStepAction.updateActionChildStep: update flow.process_step_action_child_process set display_order = :displayOrder, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStepAction.addLinkToAction: insert into flow.process_step_action_link (process_step_action_id, link_id, created_by_id) values (:processStepActionId, :linkId, :createdById)
sql.processStepAction.getActionChildLink: select psal.id, psal.process_step_action_id, psal.link_id, psal.archived, psal.created_by_id, psal.date_created, psal.modified_by_id, psal.date_modified, l.link, l.url from flow.process_step_action_link psal inner join flow.link l on l.id = psal.link_id where psal.id = :id
sql.processStepAction.deleteLinkFromAction: update flow.process_step_action_link set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStepAction.addChildFunctionToActi: insert into flow.process_step_action_company_function (process_step_action_id, company_function_id, display_order, created_by_id) values (:processStepActionId, :companyFunctionId, :displayOrder, :createdById)
sql.processStepAction.getActionChildFunction: select cp.id, cp.process_step_action_id, cp.company_function_id, cp.display_order, cp.archived, cp.date_created, cp.date_modified, cp.created_by_id, cp.modified_by_id, cf.company_function_name, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(params))) FROM ( select apdv.id, apdv.archived, dfp.db_function_id as "dbFunctionId", dfp.parameter_name as "parameterName", dfp.data_type_id as "dataTypeId", apdv.db_function_param_id as "dbFunctionParamId", apdv.process_step_action_company_function_id as "processStepActionCompanyFunctionId", apdv.dynamic_value as "dynamicValue" from flow.db_function_param dfp left join flow.action_param_dynamic_value apdv on apdv.db_function_param_id = dfp.id and apdv.process_step_action_company_function_id = cp.id where dfp.db_function_id = cf.db_function_id and dfp.parameter_type_id = 2 and apdv.archived is not true ) params), '[]') AS "actionParamDynamicValues" from flow.process_step_action_company_function cp inner join flow.company_function cf on cf.id = cp.company_function_id where cp.id = :id
sql.processStepAction.deleteActionChildFunct: update flow.process_step_action_company_function set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStepAction.updateActionChildFunct: update flow.process_step_action_company_function set display_order = :displayOrder, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStepAction.insertActionParamDynam: insert into flow.action_param_dynamic_value (db_function_param_id, process_step_action_company_function_id, dynamic_value, created_by_id, date_created) values (:dbFunctionParamId, :processStepActionCompanyFunctionId, :dynamicValue, :createdById, now());
sql.processStepAction.updateActionParamDynam: update flow.action_param_dynamic_value set dynamic_value = :dynamicValue, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStepAction.getChildFunctionsByPro: select psacf.id, psacf.archived, psacf.process_step_action_id as "processStepActionId", psacf.company_function_id as "companyFunctionId", psacf.display_order as "displayOrder", psacf.created_by_id as "createdById", psacf.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", cf.company_function_name as "companyFunctionName", df.function_name as "functionName", p.id as "projectId", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(params))) FROM ( select apdv.id, apdv.archived, dfp.db_function_id as "dbFunctionId", dfp.parameter_name as "parameterName", dfp.data_type_id as "dataTypeId", apdv.db_function_param_id as "dbFunctionParamId", apdv.process_step_action_company_function_id as "processStepActionCompanyFunctionId", apdv.dynamic_value as "dynamicValue" from flow.db_function_param dfp left join flow.action_param_dynamic_value apdv on apdv.db_function_param_id = dfp.id and apdv.process_step_action_company_function_id = psacf.id where dfp.db_function_id = cf.db_function_id and dfp.parameter_type_id = 2 and apdv.archived is not true ) params), '[]') AS "actionParamDynamicValues", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(params))) FROM ( select dfp.data_type_id as "dataTypeId", dfp.parameter_type_id as "parameterTypeId", dfp.display_order as "displayOrder", ppscfv.text_value as "textValue", ppscfv.date_value as "dateValue", ppscfv.timestamp_value as "timestampValue", ppscfv.boolean_value as "booleanValue", ppscfv.numeric_value as "numericValue", ppscfv.int_value as "intValue", dfp.system_value_id as "systemValueId", apdv.dynamic_value as "dynamicValue" from flow.db_function_param dfp left join flow.company_function_param cfp on cfp.db_function_param_id = dfp.id and cfp.archived is not true and cfp.company_function_id = cf.id left join flow.system_value sv on sv.id = dfp.system_value_id left join flow.action_param_dynamic_value apdv on apdv.db_function_param_id = dfp.id and apdv.process_step_action_company_function_id = psacf.id left join flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value ppscfv on ppscfv.project_process_step_id = pps.id and ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfp.custom_field_group_assignment_id where dfp.db_function_id = df.id and dfp.archived is not true order by dfp.display_order) params), '[]') AS "companyFunctionParams" from flow.process_step_action_company_function psacf inner join flow.company_function cf on cf.id = psacf.company_function_id inner join flow.db_function df on df.id = cf.db_function_id inner join flow.project_process_step pps on pps.id = :projectProcessStepId inner join flow.project p on p.id = pps.project_id where psacf.process_step_action_id = :id and psacf.archived is not true order by psacf.display_order, cf.company_function_name
